Our team standard: money = integer cents, percentages = percent numbers (10 = 10%), lookup miss raises KeyError. Float dollars risk rounding errors in tax (tax must be exact to the cent), and fractions vs percents is an easy mix-up with tax_pct. Proposal: pricing returns price_cents:int, discount_pct:number (10 = 10%), region:str; get_item/get_customer raise KeyError on unknown id. Tax is computed in tax.py from cents and percent numbers.
